## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (keep it minimalistic)

### For question changes

- [ ] `shortAnswer` is a complete answer someone could say out loud, under 400 characters
- [ ] `memoryHook` is a real anchor, not a restatement of the question
- [ ] Every code block has a language label
- [ ] Headings start at `##`
- [ ] Categories already exist in `data/categories.json`
- [ ] Difficulty is honest
